props.name: label
props.comment: The button text. A string is translated. Defaults to the mode's message.

props.name: mode
props.comment: `subtract` removes the matching OSM areas from the polygon; `add` merges them in.

props.name: presets
props.comment: Named OSM feature sets to query, such as `water`.

props.name: provider
props.comment: Defaults to the `overpass` of `MapsProvider`. One of the two is required.

props.name: source
props.comment: The form field holding the Polygon or MultiPolygon.

props.name: tags
props.comment: Extra Overpass tag filters, such as `natural=wood`.
